subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Refusal of the Return
description: A quick, practical guide to Refusal of the Return.

hook.text: Why would you go home? The special world has magic and meaning. Many heroes hesitate to leave.

buildup.text: After the ordeal and the reward, the hero may resist returning to the mundane ordinary world.

discovery.text: The Buddha was tempted to stay in nirvana. But compassion pulled him back to teach suffering mortals.

twist.text: Some heroes never return. They become hermits, immortals, or ghosts. The return is its own challenge.

climax.text: The refusal reveals one final truth: the hero's duty isn't to themselves but to the world they left.

punchline.text: The hardest journey is the one back home.

quiz.question: Why might a hero refuse to return?
options: The special world is more meaningful
